lines: An immobilized enemy cannot move for a short time (2 s at base). It is applied by chance on hit: from the tree, and natively by Ashlands nature weapons. It is a status of its own, not an ailment: ailment rows do not affect it. Duration rows with the immobilize chip lengthen it; many rows are stronger against immobilized enemies.

lines: An area attack against the ground. Half of its slashing and piercing damage is dealt as blunt instead, and the other half is lost; blunt, elemental and all other damage is dealt in full. Sledges’ ground attacks and alternatives turned into slams gain slam bonuses and aftershocks, are not strikes and never split damage between targets.
new.name: Slam

lines: An area attack against the ground using blunt damage as its basis. Damage converted into blunt contributes and elemental conversion from that basis remains effective; raw non-blunt damage, slashing and piercing cannot be dealt by a slam. Sledges’ ground attacks and alternatives turned into slams gain slam bonuses and aftershocks, are not strikes and never split damage between targets.
